Strategic priority
Strongly growth, diversify and transform the retail and
business bank

Key business objectives
• Be the most customer centric retail bank
• Be the transactional business bank of choice

Six focus areas
• Customer obsession: Ensure our customers get a better
and more exciting experience with us through revising
service standards, improving processes and resourcing for
customer impacting roles
• Liabilities: Enhance transactional banking capabilities,
including Twin and Zidisha Rewards propositions
• Banking: Increase our focus on growing Timiza platform
towards being the next generation virtual banking
proposition
• Payments: Tap into cash collections and transactional
opportunities in business bank
• Card: Drive card acquisition and spend through Barclaycard
Social proposition
• Ecosystem banking: Leverage on banking ecosystem
through relationship management (RM) Club to acquire
more business opportunities
